title: Fix the four reproduced full-review blockers plus the vacuous sweeps

Plus N1: make the two vacuous published-reason sweeps falsifiable with controls. Each fix pinned by new discriminating regressions in the existing gates; reviewer attack scripts are the acceptance oracles. Residual registry recorded; no scope beyond the enumerated items; 1.2 lock surface is a stop condition.
